text:
anna: CircuitHub reported several batched uploads where devices dropped sku_id and currency headers when offline. marketplace accepted events but entitlements didn't attach; ledger undercount ~28k tokens for 2026-03-12. Need quick mitigation + recon.
dan: short fix: mark incoming events with missing sku_id as `needs_enrich` and route to an enrichment worker that calls device_registry -> returns sku candidate and confidence. If confidence >= 0.9 auto-apply, 0.6-0.9 provisional, <0.6 hold + notify partner.
kai: billing ask: provisional charges should be zero until resolved; on settle we'll either issue off-cycle credit or final charge based on mapping result. propose finance review if provisional > $1000 per customer/day.
jin: ops: add ledger lease during reconcile: `ledger.acquire_lease('circuithub-recon', ttl=600)` and a metric `circuithub.enrich.provisional_applied`. Page SRE if provisional_applied spikes >300 in 10m.
anna: partner wants webhook when we apply provisional or final entitlements. sample payload they requested:
```
POST /partners/circuithub/webhooks/enrich-result
{
  "event_id":"evt-9876",
  "device_id":"ch-44",
  "mapped_sku":"ch-edge-basic",
  "confidence":0.92,
  "action":"auto_apply"
}
```
dan: quick SQL to find suspect batches (7d):
```
SELECT partner_id, batch_id, count(*) AS events, sum(usage_count) AS tokens
FROM partner_usage_events
WHERE sku_id IS NULL AND received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY partner_id, batch_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
kai: I'll use that to produce an impacted-customer list. jin: add the feature flag `circuithub_enrich_v1` so we can toggle.
jin: will add runbook entry and the ledger guard, ETA 18h. dan: will implement enrichment worker + metrics + webhook sender, ETA 36h to staging. kai: draft finance policy & customer comms, ETA 12h. anna: I'll coordinate partner QA and signature requirements.
webhook-bot: Scheduled job created: id ch-enrich-20260313-01 owner dan runs staging 2026-03-13T02:00:00Z.
anna: thanks team  let's reconvene after the staging run.
